rapport_notes: Professional and thorough but mostly transactional Q&A, no particular warmth-building moments.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No true concern raised; the customer volunteered more inventory items in response to the "any questions" line, not a worry.

top_strength: Thorough, organized floor-by-floor inventory walkthrough that ensured nothing was missed before quoting.
coaching_note: Skipped the "this is just an estimate, you only pay for actual time used" reassurance entirely -- a customer explicitly still comparison-shopping is exactly who benefits most from hearing that flexibility before declining to book.
